draft.emotion: calm and fresh, like a walk in a park in summer
notes: In the masculine personal plural, the consonant softens and the form is 'zieloni'.
A very common informal idiom is 'nie mieć zielonego pojęcia' (to have no clue / not have the foggiest idea).
